Cleavage (crystal).subject: Mining & Minerals
Cleavage (crystal).question: The _____ was Tendency of crystalline materials to split along favored planes.
Cleavage (crystal).fact: Cleavage, in mineralogy and materials science, is the tendency of crystalline materials to split along definite crystallographic structural planes. Cryptocrystalline.fact: Cryptocrystalline is a rock texture made up of such minute crystals that its crystalline nature is only vaguely revealed even microscopically in thin section by transmitted polarized light. Among the sedimentary rocks, chert and flint are cryptocrystalline.
